<div class="facts"><div class="fact"><small>Error ID</small><b>ST-DEV-002</b></div><div class="fact"><small>Area</small><b>Devices</b></div><div class="fact wide"><small>Where you see it</small><b>Device side (MQTT CONNACK); server log</b></div></div>

<div class="msg"><small>Message</small><span>MQTT CONNECT rejected: empty username (access token required)</span></div>

## Why it happens

The device's MQTT client sends no user name. For access token devices, the token must be the MQTT user name.

## Fix it

Set the MQTT user name to the device's access token and leave the password empty. For MQTT Basic devices, set client ID, user name and password exactly as on the device's **Manage credentials** dialog.

## Check that it worked

The device connects and shows **Active**.
